image_description: An underwater photograph showing a hammerhead shark swimming over a sandy seabed. The shark is viewed from a high-angle, rear-three-quarter perspective, clearly displaying its distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head), dorsal fin, pectoral fins, and caudal fin. The water is slightly murky with a greenish-blue tint.
